about: An open issue's status from its labels (task.py status, Model.kt Issue.status), and the Waiting on / Check after lines of its body (task.py field, Model.kt field). The first open status in the order input-needed, ready, on-hold, backlog wins; no status label means ready; in-review is the old name of input-needed.
